# blockchainlab-feeds

> Public JSON feeds for blockchainlab.com: hackathons/grants/bounties, events, clustered X intel and mentions (public post IDs, links, handles, short trimmed summaries, counts only), built daily.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [scripts/build_feeds.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/blob/main/scripts/build_feeds.py): builder
- [watchlist.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-feeds/blob/main/watchlist.json): watchlist

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-api](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-api): republishes hackathons and events as API datasets
- [Blockchains/blockchains.github.io](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchains.github.io): powers /events
- [Blockchains/hackathons](https://github.com/Blockchains/hackathons): human tracker of the same events
